string-array.name: motivational_quotes
string-array.item: Welcome, you stunning stack of sunshine. You\'re gonna eat it up!
Hey, you brilliant beam of light. Today’s yours to shine!
Hello, you beautiful force of nature. Go show ‘em what you\'re made of!
Welcome back, you absolute powerhouse. Let’s make magic happen!
Hey, you walking masterpiece. Time to slay the day!
Good to see you, legend. Today’s gonna be your playground!
Yo, unstoppable soul. Let’s turn dreams into reality!
Rise and shine, you vibrant spark. You\'re built for greatness!
